title: Practice 3: How a prefix changes a verb of motion

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **уходит** — present tense (3rd person singular) of уходить: imperfective (perfective partner: уйти).  Prefix **у-**: intended departure, signals absence (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
exercises.prompt: As time goes on, grief fades away.

exercises.why: **вышли** — past tense (plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: We walked out of the movie.

exercises.why: **вышло** — past tense (neuter) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: The sun came out from behind the clouds.

exercises.why: **выйдем** — future tense (1st person plural) of выйти: perfective (imperfective partner: выходить).  Prefix **вы-**: movement out of something across a threshold, exiting (из / с / от + gen.; в / на + acc.; к + dat).
exercises.prompt: Let's go out on the terrace.

exercises.why: **вошёл** — past tense (masculine) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: Tom unlocked the door and went in.

exercises.why: **придёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
exercises.prompt: Tom won't be in time.

exercises.why: **приду** — future tense (1st person singular) of прийти: perfective (imperfective partner: приходить).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
exercises.prompt: I'll be glad to come.

exercises.why: **приезжайте** — imperative (вы, plural or polite) of приезжать: imperfective (perfective partner: приехать).  Prefix **при-**: intended arrival, signals presence of the agent at a location as a result of motion (в / на + acc.; к + dat.; из / с / от + gen).
exercises.prompt: Come to Romania again.

exercises.prompt: The bears came out of hibernation.

exercises.prompt: Tom doesn't seem to be leaving.

exercises.why: **вошли** — past tense (plural) of войти: perfective (imperfective partner: входить).  Prefix **в-, во-**: movement inwards across a threshold, entering (в / на + acc).
exercises.prompt: We made it to the top three.
